item.title: Pass‑ta‑key Attack Exposes Google Passkeys on Windows
item.description: Arie Olshtein’s Pass‑ta‑key attack extracts every Google Password Manager passkey on Windows, proving malware can bypass TPM‑only storage assumptions.
